title: The fixed-false component of ordinary inverse-exchange trace transport.
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, N a natural number annihilating A, t normalized finite twist transport, S a scheme with N invertible in global sections, and f:X→S proper with i:X ≅ ProjectiveLine(S) satisfying i.hom ≫ q = f. For any morphism τ:Rq* A_P(1)[2] → A_S, the displayed ordinary inverse-exchange transport equation holds for the fixed projection a = false. This is the first component of the arbitrary-trace transport and has no splitting family, chart trace, trace base-change hypothesis, supported class or diagonal integral.

source.place: The paragraphs identifying t_p1 and t_p2 with base change of t_q, using qp1=qp2 and the composite-adjunction counit.

proof.text: Fix the Boolean projection to false. Insert the ordinary exchange factor for the projective-line square and its explicit inverse. The chart-exchange factorization [lem-sf-p1-projection-trace-transport-false-chart-pasting] moves the resulting prefix to the diagonal chart map; the factor cancellation [lem-sf-p1-projection-trace-transport-false-factor-cancel] removes the inserted inverse. The remaining composite-adjunction tail and constant-unit comparison are [lem-sf-p1-projection-trace-transport-false-tail], which is natural in the arbitrary arrow τ. Reassociate the categorical composites to obtain coordinateTrace.

lean.statement:
theorem projectionTraceTransport_false
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (N : ℕ) (hA : (N : A) = 0) (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
    {S X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [IsProper f]
    (i : X ≅ ProjectiveLine S) (hi : i.hom ≫ (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) = f)
    (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤)))
    (τ : ordinaryFiniteP1SplittingTarget A N hA S ⟶ ordinaryFiniteUnit A S) :
    middleComparison A N hA t f i hi hS false ≫
        (ordinaryFinitePullback A i.hom).map (projectionExchange A N hA t S hS false) ≫
        (ordinaryFinitePullback A i.hom).map
          ((ordinaryFinitePullback A (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)).map τ ≫
            (ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback A (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)).hom) ≫
        (constantComparison A i).hom =
      coordinateTrace A N hA t f i hi hS τ false
